receipts.label: generate
receipts.script:
ruby -rjson -rbundler -e 'puts JSON.generate({ruby:RUBY_VERSION,bundler:Bundler::VERSION,deployment:Bundler.settings[:deployment],frozen:Bundler.settings[:frozen]})'; printf 'source "https://rubygems.org"
gem "rake", "13.2.1"
' > Gemfile; bundle lock

receipts.label: matched-deployment
receipts.script:
cat > Gemfile <<'GEM'
source "https://rubygems.org"
gem "rake", "13.2.1"
GEM
cat > Gemfile.lock <<'LOCK'
GEM
  remote: https://rubygems.org/
  specs:
    rake (13.2.1)

PLATFORMS
  aarch64-linux
  ruby

DEPENDENCIES
  rake (= 13.2.1)

BUNDLED WITH
   2.6.9
LOCK
sha256sum Gemfile.lock; bundle install; result=$?; sha256sum Gemfile.lock; if [ "$result" -eq 0 ]; then bundle exec ruby -rjson -rrake -rbundler -e 'puts JSON.generate({ruby:RUBY_VERSION,bundler:Bundler::VERSION,rake:Rake::VERSION,deployment:Bundler.settings[:deployment],frozen:Bundler.settings[:frozen],bundle_path:Bundler.bundle_path.to_s})'; fi; exit "$result"
